'''Kilia IV''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kilian Rangers/Legends|Kilian Rangers]]<ref name="KTP">''[[Keeping the Peace]]''</ref> and [[Kilian Bantha]]s.<ref name="WIZ" />

Kilia IV, the only planet suitable for habitation in the [[Kilia system/Legends|Kilia system]], was a rugged, mountainous world, with inhospitable badlands and one lush valley, where its people had settled in one town and scattered rural farms and fortresses.<ref name="RES" />

Descendants of a lost colony that left the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] during one of the earlier expansion periods, the Kilians have had almost no contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] or [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] in over a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="RES" />

Most Kilians led simple lives as farmers and herders, using technology no more advanced than iron tools and oil lanterns. Only members of the noble houses retained access to higher technology, and even they lacked [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]], [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibro-weapons]].<ref name="RES" />

Noble houses of Kilia IV included [[House Fardor]], [[House Tionc]] and [[House Wallon]].<ref name="RES" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]'' places Kilia IV in the [[Unknown Regions]], while the later ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places Kilia in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. This article assumes the latter placement is correct.
